description: Use this when the user asks what is on at Horseback or what to do on given dates: this weekend, holidays (ferie, Mikołajki, Sylwester), camps, picnics, riding competitions, events for children and teenagers. Returns dated events with time, admission, registration link and the content of the event page. Do not use for regular classes without a date (use get_activities).

language.description: Language of the returned texts: "pl" (Polish, default) or "en" (English). Use the language of the conversation.

name: get_upcoming_events

contact.description: Horseback contact: phone, email, website, social profiles.

buyNowUrl.description: Online payment link ("Kup teraz" / Buy now) of an event with one variant sold online; payment on site is possible too.

buyNowUrls.description: Online payment links per variant, for an event with several variants sold online.

dateEnd.description: End date of a multi-day event (YYYY-MM-DD), if any.

title: Najbliższe wydarzenia
